name: Glitch
author: Ambrotype
description: The photo broken the way machines break it: pixel sorting, split colour channels, slid bands, torn compression blocks (datamosh), a worn video tape, ripples, smeared streaks and nudged tiles. It reads the whole photo at once.

params.name: strength
params.label: Strength
params.description: How much of the photo is broken, or how far. 0 leaves it as it is.

params.name: size
params.label: Size
params.description: How big the glitch is, as a share of the photo's short side.

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Pixel sort and Streaks: the direction, in degrees. 0 is across, 90 is down.

params.name: low
params.label: Darkest sorted
params.description: Pixel sort: only pixels at least this bright, in percent, are sorted.

params.name: high
params.label: Brightest sorted
params.description: Pixel sort: only pixels at most this bright, in percent, are sorted.

params.name: tint
params.label: Tint
params.description: Colours the result toward one hue, keeping its brightness. Stronger with Strength.

params.name: grain
params.label: Grain
params.description: Fine grey noise over the result.

params.name: marks
params.label: Grid marks
params.description: Tiles: thin dark grid lines and a small green + in each tile's centre.
